title: Automatic Sweep: Minimum Balance Requirements and Limits
summary: This document specifies Automatic Sweep rules for checking: maintain a $500 target minimum balance, and only trigger a sweep when end-of-day excess is at least $50. It allows up to 60 sweep transfers per month, pausing for the rest of the month afterward, and when triggered it transfers only the portion above $500.
faqs: What target minimum balance must I maintain for Automatic Sweep in checking?
What minimum end-of-day excess amount triggers a sweep transfer?
How many sweep transfers per month are allowed before sweeps pause?
